name: Zone 2 · Orchard - terraced fruit forest
notes:
Terraced fruit forest north of the house (phase 2, 2027 – sooner if volunteers or a collaboration can plant it out). An expansion of the fruit forest in among the eucalypts, with partial shade.
Terraces: narrow benches on contour with log or rock risers; plant the risers with lomandra or vetiver; mulch thickly, mixing in non-eucalypt mulch against the tannin litter.
Water: drip from the tank (or treated water for fruit-off-the-ground trees if inside the approved area); the canopy keeps it moister than the open slope.
Shade-tolerant fruit: jaboticaba, grumichama, Davidson's plum, finger lime, riberry (lilly pilly), abiu, black sapote, babaco; pawpaw and citrus only on the sunniest terrace edges.
Understorey: ginger, turmeric, galangal, Okinawa spinach, gotu kola. Skip introduced passionfruit (it naturalises into the bush).
Checks: inspect myrtles (jaboticaba, grumichama, lilly pilly) for myrtle rust; arborist check of limbs above the terraces.
Plan: Bright Tree planting calendar and phasing (Oct 2026).
